Swallows: Eba, amala and other soft accompaniments made for scooping up soup.
Pizza: Explore the oven: blistered crusts, bright tomatoes and toppings from basil to spicy salami.

venues.name: Ugba & Clay
venues.description: The first plate out of this Enugu kitchen is often abacha, dressed just before it reaches the table. A short menu pairs cassava and yam with the familiar flavours of oha leaves, utazi and ugba.

items.name: Abacha & Ugba
items.description: Fine ribbons of cassava are softened and tossed with sliced oil bean, palm oil and pepper, then finished with onion.

items.name: Oha Soup
items.description: Tender oha leaves go into the pot at the last moment, after cocoyam has thickened the stock.

items.name: Ofe Nsala
items.description: A pale yam-thickened broth with fish and fragrant spices; its depth comes from the stock rather than palm oil.

items.name: Peppered Yam Porridge
items.description: Chunks of yam simmer in a red pepper and palm oil base until the edges break down and thicken the pot.

items.name: Steamed Okpa
items.description: Bambara groundnut flour, palm oil and pepper are mixed into a batter and steamed until just set.

items.name: Nkwobi with Utazi
items.description: Tender pieces of cow foot are folded through a spiced palm oil dressing and topped with thin-cut utazi and onion.

venues.name: Waterleaf Courtyard
venues.description: The greens get as much attention as the stock in this Calabar kitchen. Finely sliced afang, soft waterleaf and bundles of grated cocoyam give each pot its own texture.

items.name: Afang Soup
items.description: Finely cut afang leaves and waterleaf cook down in a rich stock seasoned with crayfish and palm oil.

items.name: Edikang Ikong
items.description: Fluted pumpkin leaves and waterleaf are folded through a concentrated meat stock with dried fish.

items.name: Ekpang Nkukwo
items.description: Grated cocoyam is rolled into small leaf parcels and gently simmered with palm oil, crayfish and stock.

items.name: Bole & Grilled Fish
items.description: Roasted plantain and smoky grilled fish come with a spoonful of pepper sauce for dipping.

items.name: Catfish Pepper Soup
items.description: Thick cuts of catfish are poached in a fragrant pepper-spiced broth and finished with fresh herbs.

items.name: Coconut Rice
items.description: Rice absorbs coconut milk as it cooks, leaving soft grains scented with fresh coconut.

venues.name: The Garri Bowl
venues.description: Cold water turns toasted cassava into a cooling snack; hot water turns it into eba for scooping up soup. This Ibadan table serves garri both ways, alongside soft amala and warm puff-puff.

items.name: Soaked Garri with Groundnuts
items.description: Crunchy Ijebu garri softens in ice-cold water with milk and a little sugar. Roasted groundnuts add crunch between spoonfuls.

items.name: Yellow Eba & Egusi Soup
items.description: Yellow garri is stirred into hot water to form smooth eba. Pinch off a piece to scoop up the ground melon seed and leafy vegetable soup.

items.name: Amala with Ewedu & Gbegiri
items.description: Soft yam-flour amala meets silky jute leaves, creamy bean soup and a spoonful of red pepper stew.

items.name: Ofada Rice & Ayamase
items.description: A mound of fragrant Ofada rice accompanies a bold green pepper stew with tender pieces of meat.

items.name: Steamed Moi Moi
items.description: Peeled beans are blended with red pepper and steamed into a savoury pudding, soft enough to cut with a spoon.

items.name: Warm Puff-Puff
items.description: Yeasted dough is dropped by the spoonful into hot oil, making little rounds with a golden skin and airy centre.

venues.name: Forno delle Due Corti
venues.description: A bench for stretching dough, a wood-fired oven and a short list of toppings: this Naples pizzeria keeps the crust at the centre of the plate.

items.name: Margherita Pizza
items.description: Tomato, mozzarella and fresh basil sit inside a blistered rim, with a little olive oil added after baking.

items.name: Pizza Marinara
items.description: A thin layer of tomato is scattered with sliced garlic and oregano before the dough meets the oven floor.

items.name: Mushroom & Olive Pizza
items.description: Earthy sliced mushrooms and olives nestle into melted mozzarella on a lightly charred base.

items.name: Quattro Formaggi Pizza
items.description: Four cheeses melt into one another across the dough, from creamy mozzarella to sharp blue cheese.

items.name: Diavola Pizza
items.description: Spicy salami curls at the edges in the oven over tomato and bubbling mozzarella.

items.name: Prosciutto & Rucola Pizza
items.description: The baked base is finished with folds of prosciutto, fresh rocket and shavings of hard cheese.
